_comment: Tier B sources for next/developers/object-model pages: concepts with no speckle-bundle-spec-generated catalog to diff against (see the sync-object-model-docs skill). Each entry pins the sha256 of a source file as of the last time an agent actually read it and drew a conclusion from it. check-object-model-freshness.mjs re-hashes these sibling-checkout files and flags any that changed, so a stale conclusion gets re-verified instead of silently rotting. Update the hash (and the note, if the fact changed) whenever you re-verify or the source moves.
